source.text:
📍2️⃣9️⃣ @rocotoberlin
​​A taste of the Inca civilization right in Berlin! 🇵🇪🏛️
.
Overall rating: 9.5/10 ⭐⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Budget: 50€+ pP
.
🛖 When I visited Peru in 2024, the food culture completely blew my mind. If you’re nostalgic for those flavors or just want to try one of the best cuisines in the world, this hidden gem in Schöneberg is the answer. Tucked behind a small door and half a floor underground, it radiates pure coziness.
.
🍹 Started the only correct way: munching on roasted Peruvian corn kernels with a Chicha Morada and a Pisco Sour (one sip and I was instantly transported back to Ica!).
.
🐟 The ultimate test of any Peruvian spot is the ceviche, so we shared the mixed platter. It left me absolutely speechless, an umami flavor explosion. The Japanese-fusion tuna with a hint of wasabi was my favorite, and the avocado white fish packed an unexpected, highly appreciated spicy punch. 
Tip: If you visit and don’t order this platter, you're making a grave mistake.
.
🌮 The appetizers didn't stop there. The Chicharron tacos perfectly balanced a fatty crunch with fresh plantain and avocado puree. The cheese empanadas? Piping hot, inflated perfection dipped in aji amarillo sauce.
.
🥩 For the main, we shared a classic chifa fusion I fell in love with on my trip (and now cook at home!): Lomo Saltado. Wok-sautéed beef and veggies served over a creamy aji amarillo risotto topped with parmesan. It is highly addictive, so consider yourself warned.
.
🥭 Sealed the deal with a maracuja mousse and an ice-cold mango passionfruit sorbet served with crumble and fresh berries. Simple, visually stunning, and so satisfying. 
.
The waiters are incredibly friendly and genuinely cared about our feedback. I can't wait to go back 🤤
.
What is your favorite Peruvian dish? Drop it below! 👇
.
.
.
